metric: reach of exposure on the merge-gate metric, measured in the gate's own camera
task: phase B3 plan 3 task 4, review fix round 1
question: Can ANY exposure bring serenity under the <=16.58 all-spot legacy ceiling? Round 0 answered this by transferring an inference from the fixed-fov sweep plus a two-point same-load diagnostic 0.003 apart; review round 1 asked for the direct measurement in the gate camera, which is this file.
method: One page load, ?apt=serenity&measure=1&fov=legacy, full shipped post chain (bloom enabled, threshold 1.8, strength 0.1), only renderer.toneMappingExposure changing between captures, frames re-captured fresh per point into their own folder, scored with tools/delta_e.py's own cell_means()/ciede2000() over every compare-flagged spot (all-spot, 11 of 11). One load means one set of the procedural textures materials.js randomises, so the differences between these rows are exposure and nothing else.
notAFit: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, run after 0.329 was chosen, committed and verified. The shipped value is the luminance fit and does not move; choosing an exposure because it scored better on dE2000 is the rule violation this phase exists to prevent. This file exists so the merge owner knows whether a passing exposure exists at all. It does not.
result: The curve is a shallow U with its minimum at exposure 0.32, dE2000 16.6085 -- above the 16.58 ceiling. The best exposure anywhere in the neighbourhood is worth 0.0057 against the shipped 0.329 (16.6142): a sixth of the 0.03 shortfall and a seventh of this metric's repeat-run noise floor. Both ends rise (16.6424 at 0.30, 16.6437 at 0.34) and the fixed-camera sweep shows it keeps rising far out (19.17 at 0.6, 22.58 at 1.0). NO EXPOSURE PASSES THIS GATE.
corroboration: Six independent readings above the ceiling across three tasks and two exposures: serenity-b3-task2-fix1-allspots.json 16.60 and serenity-b3-task3-off-allspots.json 16.61, both at the old 0.326 and both predating this task, plus task 4's four runs at 0.329 (16.60, 16.62, 16.61, 16.60).
windingDefect: Measured against a render carrying the deferred grid() winding defect (8 of 12 wall faces backwards, bake.js). Re-run this when that fix lands.
